text:
```yaml
name: DCO Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  dco-check:
    name: Verify DCO Sign-off
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check DCO Sign-off
        run: |
          echo "Checking DCO sign-off for commits..."
          
          # Get all commits in the PR except merge commits
          COMMITS=$(git log --pretty=format:"%H" HEAD~${{ github.event.pull_request.commits }}..HEAD)
          
          FAILED=false
          for commit in $COMMITS; do
            if ! git show --format="%b" "$commit" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              echo "❌ Commit $commit is missing DCO sign-off"
              FAILED=true
            fi
          done
          
          if [ "$FAILED" = true ]; then
            echo "❌ DCO check failed: All commits must have a 'Signed-off-by:' line."
            echo ""
            echo "To fix this, amend your commits with:"
            echo "  git commit --amend --signoff"
            echo ""
            echo "Or for multiple commits:"
            echo "  git rebase --interactive --signoff <base-branch>"
            echo ""
            echo "For more information, see: https://developercertificate.org/"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ All commits have DCO sign-off"
          fi
```
